function.description: Retrieve records from any Odoo model with filtering capabilities. Specify model, domain, fields, limit, offset, and optional ORM order. Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.
function.name: odoo_record_retriever

anyOf.description: Standard Odoo domain. Use JSON scalar arrays for in/not in values.

operation.description: Omit to use the legacy search contract.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Identify the customer-facing commercial order header and inspect its schema without reading records.

- **所属销售订单关系**：
  - 字段：`order_id`
  - 类型：many2one
  - 关联模型：`sale.order`

## 与“商品和数量”直接相关的字段

| 业务含义 | 字段 | 类型 | 关联/说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 商品 | `product_id` | many2one | 关联 `product.product` |
| 数量 | `product_uom_qty` | float | 销售订单数量 |
| 数量单位 | `product_uom` | many2one | 关联 `uom.uom` |
| 商品描述 | `name` | text | 明细行描述 |

function.description: Retrieve records from any Odoo model with filtering capabilities. Specify model, domain, fields, limit, offset, and optional ORM order. Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

- **Child record type:** `sale.order.line`

This is the standard child model for item and quantity lines on a customer sales order.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message.   - `product_id` → `product.product`

  - `product_uom_qty` — ordered quantity  
  - `product_uom` — unit of measure  
  - `price_unit` — unit price  
  - `discount` — discount  
  - `price_subtotal` — untaxed subtotal  
  - `price_tax` — tax  
  - `price_total` — total  
- **Description field:** `name`
- **Potential status fields:** `state`, `invoice_status`, `qty_delivered`, `qty_invoiced`

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. 已完成**仅模式发现与字段/关系定义识别**，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改任何工作簿。

## 最符合“整张仓库操作单据”的核心对象

### `stock.picking`
- **业务描述**：Transfer（库存调拨/仓库操作单据）
- **显示字段**：`name`（Reference）
- **适用范围**：收货、发货、内部调拨等实际仓库操作单据。
- **操作类型字段**：`picking_type_code`（Type of Operation）
- **状态字段**：`state`
- **关键仓库关系**：
  - `location_id`：源库位
  - `location_dest_id`：目标库位
  - `picking_type_id`：操作类型
  - `warehouse_address_id`：仓库地址
- **相关业务单据关系**：
  - `inbound_order_id` → `world.depot.inbound.order`
  - `outbound_order_id` → `world.depot.outbound.order`
  - `transfer_order_id` → `world.depot.transfer.order`
- **明细集合**：
  - `move_ids` → `stock.move`
  - `move_line_ids` → `stock.move.line`
  - `package_level_ids` → `stock.package_level`
  - `package_scan_lines` → `stock.picking.package.scan`

## 相关上层业务对象

### `world.depot.inbound.order`
- **描述**：Inbound Order（收货订单）
- **显示字段**：`billno`
- **类型字段**：`type`，包括 Inbound、Service、Transfer
- **关联实际操作单据**：`stock_picking_id` → `stock.picking`
- **主要明细**：
  - `inbound_order_product_ids` → `world.depot.inbound.order.product`
  - `actual_pallet_lines` → `world.depot.inbound.order.actual.pallet`
  - `inbound_order_doc_ids` → `world.depot.inbound.order.docs`

### `world.depot.outbound.order`
- **描述**：Outbound Order（发货订单）
- **显示字段**：`billno`
- **类型字段**：`type`，包括 Outbound、Service、Transfer
- **操作单据关系**：
  - `outgoing_picking_lines` → `stock.picking`
  - `picking_PICK`、`picking_Out` → `stock.picking`
- **主要明细**：
  - `outbound_order_product_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.product`
  - `outbound_order_pack_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.pack.info`
  - `outbound_order_docs_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.docs`

### `world.depot.transfer.order`
- **描述**：Transfer Order（调拨订单）
- **显示字段**：`billno`
- **关联实际操作单据**：`stock_picking_id` → `stock.picking`
- **主要明细**：
  - `line_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.line`
  - `doc_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.docs`
  - `charge_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.charge`

## 结论

如果后续导出目标是**仓库收货、发货或内部调拨时实际使用的整张操作单据**，首选业务对象是：

> **`stock.picking`（Transfer）**

其中 `world.depot.inbound.order`、`world.depot.outbound.order` 和 `world.depot.transfer.order` 是与该实际操作单据关联的上层业务订单对象。

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. 已完成**仅架构/字段关系准备**，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改任何工作簿。

## 结论

“仓库人员执行一次收货或发运时打开的主单据”在当前系统中有两层含义：

### 1. 业务主单据

- **收货主单据**：`world.depot.inbound.order`
  - 描述：Inbound Order
  - 单据名称字段：`billno`
  - 关键关系：
    - `stock_picking_id` → `stock.picking`
    - `inbound_order_product_ids` → `world.depot.inbound.order.product`
    - `actual_pallet_lines` → `world.depot.inbound.order.actual.pallet`
    - `inbound_order_doc_ids` → `world.depot.inbound.order.docs`
    - `inbound_order_charge_ids` → `world.depot.inbound.order.charge`
    - `warehouse` → `stock.warehouse`
    - `pick_type` → `stock.picking.type`
    - `owner` → `res.partner`
    - `waybill_id` → `world.depot.waybill`

- **发运主单据**：`world.depot.outbound.order`
  - 描述：Outbound Order
  - 单据名称字段：`billno`
  - 关键关系：
    - `picking_PICK`、`picking_Out` → `stock.picking`
    - `outgoing_picking_lines` → `stock.picking`
    - `outbound_order_product_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.product`
    - `outbound_order_pack_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.pack.info`
    - `outbound_order_product_serial_numbers` → `world.depot.outbound.order.product.serial.number`
    - `outbound_order_docs_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.docs`
    - `outbound_order_charge_ids` → `world.depot.outbound.order.charge`
    - `warehouse` → `stock.warehouse`
    - `pick_type` → `stock.picking.type`
    - `owner`、`consignee_id`、`delivery_partner_id` → `res.partner`

### 2. 仓库实际操作单据

- **`stock.picking`**
  - 描述：Transfer
  - 单据名称字段：`name`
  - 这是仓库收货、拣货、发运等实际库存操作打开的标准操作单。
  - 操作类型由 `picking_type_id` → `stock.picking.type` 标识。
  - 关键关系：
    - `inbound_order_id` → `world.depot.inbound.order`
    - `outbound_order_id` → `world.depot.outbound.order`
    - `move_ids` → `stock.move`
    - `move_line_ids` → `stock.move.line`
    - `package_level_ids` → `stock.package_level`
    - `location_id`、`location_dest_id` → `stock.location`
    - `partner_id`、`owner_id` → `res.partner`
    - `warehouse_address_id` → `res.partner`
    - `batch_id` → `stock.picking.batch`

因此：

- 若问题中的“主单据”指仓库业务订单：分别是  
  **`world.depot.inbound.order`（收货）** 和 **`world.depot.outbound.order`（发运）**。
- 若指仓库人员实际执行收货或发运时打开的操作界面：核心数据类型是  
  **`stock.picking`（Transfer）**，并通过 `inbound_order_id` 或 `outbound_order_id` 关联业务主单据。

Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Identify the warehouse transfer document rather than its individual product movement rows.

message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed; no business records were read and no workbook was created or modified.

**Identified business object:** `world.depot.transfer.order` — **Transfer Order**  
This is the document-level object, rather than its individual movement rows.

**Relevant document fields:**
- `billno` — Bill No; record name
- `reference` — Reference
- `date` — Order Date
- `t_date` — Transfer Date
- `state` — State: New, Confirmed, Cancelled
- `type` — Order Type
- `warehouse` — Warehouse (`stock.warehouse`)
- `owner` — Owner (`res.partner`)
- `pick_type` — Picking Type (`stock.picking.type`)
- `from_location_type` — From Type
- `to_location_type` — To Type
- `stock_picking_id` — Related Picking (`stock.picking`)
- `project` — Project (`project.project`)
- `project_category_id` — Project Category
- `remark`, `remark1` — Remarks
- `confirm_time_server`, `confirm_time_user_tz` — Confirmation timestamps
- `confirm_user_id` — Confirmed By

**Relevant relationships:**
- `line_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.line` — Transfer Order Lines  
  *Excluded from the document-level result because the request explicitly excludes individual movement rows.*
- `stock_picking_id` → `stock.picking` — Related warehouse transfer
- `charge_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.charge` — Transfer Order Charges
- `doc_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.docs` — Transfer Order Documents

The standard Odoo `stock.picking` model was also identified as **Transfer**, but the custom `world.depot.transfer.order` model is the more direct match for the requested warehouse transfer document.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 识别仓库操作单据下代表某项货物移动计划的明细数据对象。

已完成**仅架构层面的识别**，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

## 最匹配的业务对象

### 明细数据对象：`world.depot.transfer.order.line`
- **说明**：Transfer Order Line（调拨/转移操作单明细）
- **所属单据对象**：`world.depot.transfer.order`
- **父子关系**：
  - 父对象字段：`world.depot.transfer.order.line_ids`
  - 明细对象反向字段：`transfer_order_id`

该对象最符合“仓库操作单据下代表某项货物移动计划的明细数据对象”。

## 关键字段定义

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `transfer_order_id` | many2one → `world.depot.transfer.order` | 所属仓库转移单 |
| `product` | many2one → `product.product` | 货物/产品 |
| `quantity` | float | 移动数量 |
| `location_from` | many2one → `stock.location` | 起始库位 |
| `location_to` | many2one → `stock.location` | 目标库位 |
| `project` | many2one → `project.project` | 项目 |
| `project_category_id` | many2one → `product.category` | 项目类别/产品类别 |
| `remark` | text | 备注 |

## 相关父单据对象

### `world.depot.transfer.order`
代表仓库转移/调拨操作单，包含：
- `billno`：单据号
- `state`：单据状态
- `date`：订单日期
- `t_date`：转移日期
- `warehouse`：仓库
- `line_ids`：转移单明细集合
- `stock_picking_id`：关联的库存转移单

## 区分说明

标准库存模型中还存在：

- `stock.move`：库存移动计划/操作层明细
- `stock.move.line`：库存移动的详细执行行，包含批次、包装、实际完成数量、起止库位等

但根据“仓库操作单据下”的业务语义，当前最直接对应的是：

> **`world.depot.transfer.order.line` — 仓库转移单明细**

Schema-only preparation complete. No business records were read, and no workbook was created or modified.

**Best-fit business object:** `stock.move` — **Stock Move**  
This represents the planned movement of one product within a warehouse transfer.

**Relevant relationship chain:**

- `stock.picking` — **Transfer**
  - `move_ids` → `stock.move`
- `stock.move` — **Stock Move**
  - `picking_id` → `stock.picking`
  - `product_id` → `product.product`
  - `move_line_ids` → `stock.move.line`
- `stock.move.line` — **Product Moves / detailed operations**
  - `move_id` → `stock.move`
  - `picking_id` → `stock.picking`
  - `product_id` → `product.product`

**Relevant `stock.move` fields:**

- `name` — Description
- `product_id` — Product
- `product_uom_qty` — Demand
- `product_uom` — Unit of Measure
- `location_id` — Source Location
- `location_dest_id` — Intermediate Location
- `location_final_id` — Final Location
- `picking_id` — Transfer
- `date` — Date Scheduled
- `state` — Status
- `move_line_ids` — Detailed move operations

**Interpretation:**  
Use `stock.move` as the primary export object. Include `move_line_ids` only when detailed operational lines—such as lots, packages, exact quantities, or actual source/destination locations—are required.

已完成架构识别，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

### 识别结果

整张仓库调拨单可对应：

- **模型**：`world.depot.transfer.order`
- **说明**：Transfer Order（调拨单）
- **商品明细关系**：`line_ids`
- **关系类型**：一对多（one2many）
- **明细模型**：`world.depot.transfer.order.line`
- **反向字段**：`transfer_order_id`

### “每个商品的移动任务”数据类型

后者应识别为 **调拨单明细/商品移动任务记录**，技术模型为：

```text
world.depot.transfer.order.line
```

它不是整张调拨单，而是调拨单下的逐商品明细记录。

相关字段定义包括：

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `transfer_order_id` | many2one → `world.depot.transfer.order` | 所属整张调拨单 |
| `product` | many2one → `product.product` | 商品 |
| `quantity` | float | 调拨数量 |
| `location_from` | many2one → `stock.location` | 源库位 |
| `location_to` | many2one → `stock.location` | 目标库位 |
| `project` | many2one → `project.project` | 项目 |
| `project_category_id` | many2one → `product.category` | 项目类别 |
| `remark` | text | 备注 |

补充：标准库存流程中也存在 `stock.move`（Stock Move，库存移动）模型；但针对你描述的“整张仓库调拨单及其中每个商品的移动任务”，当前系统中语义最直接对应的是 `world.depot.transfer.order` 与其 `line_ids` 明细模型 `world.depot.transfer.order.line`。

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. 已完成**仅架构层面的识别与字段查看**，未读取任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

## 主要业务对象

### 1. 出库业务单据：`world.depot.outbound.order`
- 业务名称：Outbound Order（出库单/出库业务订单）
- 显示名称字段：`billno`
- 适合作为仓库向外发货的业务单据主对象。

关键字段包括：

- 单据标识：`billno`、`reference`、`vsourcebillcode`
- 日期：`date`、`p_date`、`o_date`、`eta`、`load_date`
- 状态：`state`、`status`
- 单据类型：`type`
- 仓库：`warehouse`
- 收发货方：`owner`、`consignee_id`、`delivery_company`、`delivery_partner_id`、`unload_company`
- 交付信息：`delivery_method`、`delivery_number`、`delivery_city`、`delivery_country_id`、`delivery_street`、`delivery_zip`
- 物流信息：`load_ref`、`plate_number`、`transport_cost`、`picking_Out`、`picking_PICK`
- 备注：`remark`、`remark1`、`delivery_remark`

## 相关关系

主单据 `world.depot.outbound.order` 包含：

- `outbound_order_product_ids`
  - 关系模型：`world.depot.outbound.order.product`
  - 出库产品明细
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

- `outgoing_picking_lines`
  - 关系模型：`stock.picking`
  - 出库拣货/库存转移单
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

- `outbound_order_product_serial_numbers`
  - 关系模型：`world.depot.outbound.order.product.serial.number`
  - 产品序列号明细
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

- `outbound_order_pack_ids`
  - 关系模型：`world.depot.outbound.order.pack.info`
  - 包装信息
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

- `outbound_order_charge_ids`
  - 关系模型：`world.depot.outbound.order.charge`
  - 出库费用
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

- `outbound_order_docs_ids`
  - 关系模型：`world.depot.outbound.order.docs`
  - 单据附件/其他文件
  - 反向字段：`outbound_order_id`

## 出库产品明细对象

### `world.depot.outbound.order.product`
业务名称：Outbound Order Product

关键字段包括：

- 关联主单：`outbound_order_id`
- 产品：`product_id`
- 产品编码：`default_code`、`product_ean`、`source_product_code`
- 数量：`quantity`、`ninnum`、`u8_aux_qty`
- 批次/序列号：`lot_name`、`serial_numbers`、`is_lot`、`is_serial_tracked`
- 包装/托盘：`package_id`、`package_barcode`、`pallet_no`、`pallets`
- 库位：`locations`
- 重量：`weight`、`weight_subtotal`、`gross_weight`
- 容器：`cntr_no`
- 生产及有效期：`m_date`、`e_date`
- 备注：`remark`

## 标准库存出库/拣货对象

### `stock.picking`
- 业务名称：Transfer（库存转移/拣货单）
- 显示名称字段：`name`
- 与出库业务单据的关系：
  - `outbound_order_id` → `world.depot.outbound.order`

关键字段包括：

- 单据编号：`name`
- 单据状态：`state`
- 操作类型：`picking_type_id`、`picking_type_code`
- 来源及目标库位：`location_id`、`location_dest_id`
- 计划及完成时间：`scheduled_date`、`planning_date`、`date_done`
- 联系方：`partner_id`
- 承运商及追踪：`carrier_id`、`carrier_tracking_ref`
- 库存移动关系：`move_ids`、`move_line_ids`
- 出库单关联：`outbound_order_id`

结论：对于“仓库向外发货”的业务语义，首选主对象是 **`world.depot.outbound.order`**；其产品明细为 **`world.depot.outbound.order.product`**，实际库存拣货/转移单为 **`stock.picking`**。

Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Find the business document used to record outbound fulfillment from the warehouse. Inspect its schema only.

## 结论

“发给客户的仓库出货单”最匹配的业务数据类型是：

- **模型：** `world.depot.outbound.order`
- **业务名称：** Outbound Order（出库单 / 仓库出货单）
- **记录名称字段：** `billno`
- **状态字段：** `status`
  - Planning：计划中
  - Picking：拣货中
  - Outbound：已出库
- **订单类型字段：** `type`
  - Outbound：出库
  - Service：服务
  - Transfer：调拨

因此，它属于**仓库出库订单 / 出货订单**，而不是运输提单（`world.depot.waybill`）。

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `billno` | char | 出库单号 |
| `reference` | char | 参考号 |
| `date` | date | 订单日期 |
| `o_date` | date | 出库日期 |
| `p_date` | date | 计划日期 |
| `status` | selection | 出库业务状态 |
| `state` | selection | 单据状态：新建、确认、取消 |
| `type` | selection | 订单类型 |
| `warehouse` | many2one → `stock.warehouse` | 仓库 |

| `delivery_city` | char | 交付城市 |

| `remark` | 明细备注 |

### 其他已发现的出库单关系

- `outbound_order_docs_ids` → 其他出库单文件
- `outbound_order_pack_ids` → 包装信息
- `outbound_order_charge_ids` → 出库费用
- `outbound_order_product_serial_numbers` → 出库商品序列号
- `outgoing_picking_lines` → 出库拣配记录（`stock.picking`）
- `payable_lines` → 应付明细

## 相关但不同的业务对象

### `world.depot.waybill`

- 业务名称：Waybill（运单 / 提单）
- 记录名称字段：`bl_number`
- 更适用于运输、提单、船运、清关和交接信息。
- 其中包含 `handover_do_no`（Delivery Order No.，提货单号），但它不是仓库出库订单本身。

因此，若问题指的是**仓库向客户发货的出库单**，应使用 `world.depot.outbound.order`；若指的是**运输提单或交付运输文件**，才考虑 `world.depot.waybill`。

Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 识别财务账簿中正式登记借贷事项的会计凭证数据对象。

message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed; no business records were read and no workbook was created or modified.

**Identified business object**
- **Model:** `account.move`
- **Description:** Journal Entry
- **Display field:** `name` — Number

**Relevant fields**
- `name` — Number
- `date` — Date
- `ref` — Reference
- `move_type` — Type, including **Journal Entry** (`entry`)
- `state` — Status: Draft, Posted, Cancelled
- `journal_id` — Journal (`account.journal`)
- `company_id` — Company (`res.company`)
- `partner_id` — Partner (`res.partner`)
- `currency_id` — Currency (`res.currency`)
- `amount_untaxed` — Untaxed Amount
- `amount_tax` — Tax
- `amount_total` — Total
- `line_ids` — Journal Items (`account.move.line`), inverse field `move_id`
- `invoice_line_ids` — Invoice lines (`account.move.line`), inverse field `move_id`
- `reversed_entry_id` — Reversal of (`account.move`)
- `reversal_move_ids` — Reversal Move (`account.move`), inverse field `reversed_entry_id`

The accounting document used to post journal transactions is therefore **`account.move` (Journal Entry)**.

message.content:
已完成**架构识别准备**，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

- **一般交易业务单据**：在 `account.move` 中通常由 `move_type` 区分，例如：
  - `out_invoice`：客户发票
  - `in_invoice`：供应商账单
  - `out_refund` / `in_refund`：红字/贷项单据
  - `out_receipt` / `in_receipt`：收据类单据
- **记入账簿的凭证**：模型为 **`account.move`**，其 `move_type` 字段值为：
  - `entry`：**Journal Entry（会计分录/记账凭证）**

相关定义：

- 凭证主表：`account.move`
- 凭证状态：`state`，包括 `draft`、`posted`、`cancel`
- 账簿/日记账：`journal_id`，关联 `account.journal`
- 记账日期：`date`
- 凭证编号：`name`
- 凭证明细：`line_ids`，一对多关联 `account.move.line`
- 明细标签：`line_ids` 的业务模型描述为 **Journal Item（会计分录行/记账明细）**

因此，后者的数据类型应识别为：

> **会计凭证/记账凭证（Journal Entry），技术模型为 `account.move`，筛选条件为 `move_type = 'entry'`；其账簿明细位于 `account.move.line`。**

Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept.
